import calendar
from datetime import date, timedelta

def get_next_month(self, max_date):
    # month_no is zero-based (Java Calendar style)
    total = self.month_no + 1
    y = self.year + total // 12
    m = total % 12 + 1
    first = date(y, m, 1)
    if max_date:
        max_d = calendar.monthrange(y, m)[1]
        result = first + timedelta(days=max_d - 1)
    else:
        result = first + timedelta(days=self.day - 1)
    return "%d-%d-%d" % (result.year, result.month, result.day)
